terms: This quote includes up to 80 hours of work (60 hours installation and setup, 20 of them free, plus 20 hours R&D development). Any work beyond 80 hours is charged separately at $180.00 per hour.
Integrations marked 'best effort' depend on the device and manufacturer supporting Home Assistant. If a device can't be integrated reliably, it is not charged as extra hours.
Home Assistant remote access and cloud backup run on a Nabu Casa subscription, paid by the client directly.
The network is priced separately and can be accepted on its own.
Prices are valid for 30 days. Hardware prices may change if the supplier's prices change before order.
hyperCare: For 60 days after handover, we provide support and bug fixes to keep the system working as delivered, within the quoted scope. New features, extra devices or changes to scope are quoted separately.
warranty: 2 years, hardware only. Supplied hardware is covered for 2 years. Re-installation, replacement labour and re-programming are quoted separately.
